title: Facility Energy and Utilities Report
period: This report covers the fiscal year from {start} to {end}.
currency_line: All costs in this report are stated in {cur}.
scale_note: Both consumption columns in this table are stated in thousands of {unit}.
mult_note: Meter {meter} was replaced in {month}; for {month2} and every later month in this report, the figure shown is the register reading, which must be multiplied by {mult} to give consumption.
corr_note: The consumption shown for meter {meter} in {month} was misreported; the corrected consumption is {value} {unit}, and the cost shown is unchanged.
sub_note: Meter {sub} is a sub-meter of {main}; its consumption and cost are already included in the figures of {main2} and must not be added again.
est_note: The estimated reading for meter {meter} in {month} (reported in the previous fiscal year's report) has been replaced by an actual reading of {value} {unit}, with a restated cost of {cost} {cur}.
no_adjustments: There are no prior-period adjustments in this report.
decoy_budget: The approved budget for meter {meter} in {month} was revised to {value} {cur}.
decoy_prior: In {month} of the prior year, meter {meter} recorded {value} {unit}.

conventions_intro: This document sets out the energy-reporting conventions of the company and must be followed exactly when consolidating facility reports. The table below lists the exact conversion factor from every unit used in the facility reports to MWh; apply these factors exactly as written and do not substitute factors from any other source.
conventions_rules: Facility totals are for calendar year {year} (January to December), which spans two fiscal-year reports, so months must be taken from both reports and months outside {year2} are excluded.
Energy is reported in MWh using the factor table exactly.
Each month's cost is converted to USD at that month's rate (USD per one unit of the currency) from the FX table, and the annual average row is for reference only.
Read type A means actual and E means estimate, and an estimate stands unless a later report's prior-period adjustment replaces it.
A note that a table is stated in thousands applies to both consumption columns of that table.
Meter replacement notes with a multiplier, sub-meter notes and correction notes in a report must be applied as written.
The budget and prior-year columns are not consumption or cost.
Report energy to 3 decimals and cost to 2 decimals, and values within 0.1% are accepted.
fx_note: Monthly exchange rates in USD per one unit of {cur}, with an annual average row for reference.
intro: {company} operates {n} manufacturing facilities, identified by consecutive facility ids from {first} to {last}. Compute for each facility its total energy in MWh and its total utility cost in USD for calendar year {year}, following the conventions document exactly. Every facility has two fiscal-year reports that both contain months of that calendar year; the tables use different units and currencies, and the notes and prior-period adjustments change figures.
answer_line: The final answer is one JSON object mapping every facility id to its energy_mwh and cost_usd, for example {example}. Each facility is graded separately and counts only if both values are within 0.1%.

tools.list_facilities: Lists the facilities with their id, name, city, currency, fiscal year-end month and report ids, paged.
tools.read_report: Reads one report by id, returning about 8k characters per page with an optional character offset.
tools.read_conventions: Reads the conventions document containing the conversion factor table.
tools.read_fx: Reads monthly USD rates for one currency over an optional month range.
tools.search_report: Performs a case-insensitive text search within one facility's reports.

unit_prompt: You are computing the totals for one facility. Using the tools and following the conventions document exactly, compute calendar year {year} total energy in MWh and total cost in USD for facility {fid}: read both of its fiscal-year reports, take only the months that fall in that calendar year, apply every note and prior-period adjustment, convert all energy to MWh with the factor table and all costs to USD with the monthly FX rates, then sum. End with exactly one final line of the literal form: UNIT | {fid2} | <energy_mwh> | <cost_usd>.
